name: Maelstrom Eye Lip
core_rationale: Northernmost inverted basalt sea-lip of Perigee Abyss at [1, 0] overhanging the eye of the northern ocean whirlpool where Vesper's tear first struck the sea.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Divers swear that at dead low tide, the roaring eye of the whirlpool parts to reveal a staircase of dry star-glass descending into the seabed.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A jagged basalt lip surrounded by a vertical wall of spinning silver sea-foam that never falls back down.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Does the star-glass staircase at the bottom of the Maelstrom Eye lead to Vesper's submerged dream-palace?

causal_continuity.evidence: Marks the exact epicenter of scar-vesper-crater at the lowest rim of Perigee Abyss.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A basalt sea-lip overhanging a vertical wall of spinning silver whirlpool spray.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: terrain tile and prop kit metrics for 1.05m characters will be bound when promoted to Canon.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: gated behind the North fog_of_lore portal on town-perigee-diving-station.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null and complete mystery_hook without generating filler map geometry.
